Statistics of [[Czechoslovak First League]] in the 1931–32 season. [[Raymond Braine]] was the league's top scorer with 16 goals.<ref>{{cite book|first=Luboš|last=Jeřábek|title=Český a československý fotbal - lexikon osobností a klubů|publisher=Grada Publishing|language=Czech|year=2007|location=Prague, Czech Republic|isbn=978-80-247-1656-5|page=231}}</ref>

==Overview==
It was contested by 9 teams, and [[Sparta Prague]] won the championship.
